calls.taken: Someone else on the team already answered.
calls.microphone: Allow microphone access to answer calls.
calls.leaveWarning: You are on a call. Leaving will hang it up.

settings.title: WhatsApp calls
settings.on: On: customers can call you from WhatsApp and the call rings in the inbox of whoever is online.
settings.off: Customers don't see the call button. Once on, calls ring in the inbox and your team answers from the browser (with a microphone).
settings.coexistence: Not available with coexistence: Meta only allows calls on numbers connected only to the API (without the WhatsApp Business app).
settings.tierLow: Meta requires a messaging limit of 2,000 unique recipients a day or more to turn on calls. This number is at {tier}: move up by sending more quality messages.
settings.hoursHelp: Outside those hours WhatsApp invites the customer to send a message.

ai.title: Who answers the calls?
ai.description: Choose whether this number's calls are answered by your team from the inbox, by a voice AI agent, or both.

modeHelp.humans: Calls ring in the inbox and your team answers them.
modeHelp.ai: The AI agent answers every call right away.
modeHelp.schedule: The AI answers during the hours you choose; the rest of the time calls ring in the inbox.
modeHelp.fallback: Calls ring in the inbox first; if nobody answers in a few seconds, the AI does.

ai.noAgents: You don't have AI agents yet. Create one in AI agents and come back.
ai.agentHelp: It uses the agent's instructions, knowledge and skills (bookings, catalog, handing over to a person).
ai.noHours: Add the days and hours when the AI answers.
ai.hoursHelp: Business time. Outside these hours calls ring in the inbox.
ai.fallbackSeconds: Seconds ringing before the AI answers
ai.fallbackHelp: Between {min} and {max}. WhatsApp drops the call if nobody answers in about 45 seconds.
ai.greetingPlaceholder: Hi, thanks for calling {business}. How can I help you?
ai.greetingHelp: Leave it empty to use a greeting with the business and agent names. {business} is replaced by the business name.
ai.noteCost: Each minute the AI answers costs {n} tokens (a started minute counts as a full one).
ai.noteTools: The AI can check times, book and cancel appointments, and look up products if the agent has those skills. Confirmations also reach the customer on WhatsApp.
ai.noteHuman: If the customer asks for a person, the AI hands the conversation to your team and creates the task "Call the customer back".
ai.noteTranscript: After the call, the transcript and a summary are left as an internal note in the conversation.
ai.noteFallback: If the AI can't answer (no tokens or the service is down), the call rings in the inbox.

block.no_service: The AI voice service isn't active on the platform yet. Meanwhile, calls ring in the inbox.
block.no_key: The OpenAI key isn't set up on the platform. Meanwhile, calls ring in the inbox.
block.no_tokens: You're out of AI tokens. Meanwhile, calls ring in the inbox.
